output.headline: Routine consumables for the headset build, in line with past approvals.

reasons.text: Electrode supplies for the headset match P-18, which the treasurer approved as consumables for the same build.
C-05 asks for consumables sized to one build cycle; one set of electrodes, paste and leads fits that.
It is under the [[S-threshold-C-06]] mark in C-06, so no extra project-lead sign-off is needed, and Project Hardware keeps [[S-line-remaining-after]].
